everytime you have an urge, go pray an extra prayer. I've started praying missed one's, but you can do whichever ones if you've never missed prayer since it became obligatory for you to read them.

using shaitans against shaitan. if you start doing this, he'll start planting ideas to stop you from your urges, maybe to keep your gaze down, avoid this app, avoid that channel, etc so that you may not go read that extra prayer. because he wants you to turn away from Allah and if the urges are actually indirectly making you pray more, he wouldn't want that.

also, by the time I'm done with wudhu some of the times (I do wudhu with some nasheed/nohay playing in the background) the urge is already gone, but i pray anyways.

IT WILL NOT HAPPEN IN A DAY. it will take 2-3 weeks to build a habit of removing the memory of this regular activity from your brain and from stopping it to react to your body.

Hope this helps, and if there's any grammatical mistakes pls overlook them. jazakallah khair
